x-m-e1-06.title: Linjani ubume bento esebhokisini?

x-m-e1-06.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala imo yebhokisi, imo yesilinda, nemo yebhola, kwaye kwisikhomba ngasinye phawula iimo ezinokwenzeka.

x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.0.info: Isikhomba 1: Xa ndiyisunduza ngesandla sam, yajikajika yaza yajikajika.

x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Usebenzise isikhomba esitsha ukukhetha imo enengaphezulu elithe tyaba. Ulungise umbono wakho.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Isikhomba 3: Ndive ubuso apho kwakukho incwadi khona, kwaye yimo ethe tyaba, ejikelezileyo.

x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Idayisi yimo yebhokisi, ngoko ubuso bayo bubisikwere.

x-m-e1-06.s.s2.r.a: Ubuza ngempawu apho iimo ezimbini zinika iimpendulo ezahlukileyo.
x-m-e1-06.s.s2.r.b: Zombini imo yebhokisi nemo yesilinda zinobuso obuthe tyaba, ngoko zombini ziphendula ngo-"ewe." Ayinakwahlula zombini.
x-m-e1-06.s.s2.r.c: Ubala alunanto yakwenza nemo, ngoko akunakwahlula iimo.
x-m-e1-06.s.s2.explain: Ubuso obuthe tyaba bemo yebhokisi bubisikwere, kwaye ubuso obuthe tyaba bemo yesilinda bubusangqa. Umbuzo olungileyo yileyo iimo ezimbini ziyiphendula ngokwahlukeneyo. Ukuba kukho ubuso obuthe tyaba okanye hayi kuphuma "ewe" kuzo zombini iimo, ngoko akunakuzahlula zombini.
